lines: I remember the cure like a bell under <wavy>water</wavy>. You were there when it rang clear.
Whatever <pulse>mercy</pulse> found me, it came through your hands.
You helped pull me back when even my name felt far away.
My memory kneels and trembles. I know you, but not cleanly.
I remember weakness, bitterness, gold, and then breath. The rest is <wavy>prayer smoke</wavy>.
The memory is rough around the edges, but your face stayed in it.
I remember you from the edge of a <color:dark_purple>curse</color>. Forgive me if my thanks sounds afraid.
I know you helped. I also remember why my hands still shake.
The cure left <wavy>echoes</wavy> behind. Stand where I can breathe around them.
